title: Men's Chess – I Blunder With Confidence Tee
hook: I blunder with confidence: a chess shirt for the player who slams a piece down with a grin while his own king is already on the floor, made for the club night, the coffee-shop board and the family game that ends in a loud "I meant to do that."
art: The print is a 1950s game-box illustration of a smug man in horn-rimmed glasses and a striped red, navy and mustard cardigan, chin on his fist and a red chess piece under it, with a cracked checkerboard in front of him and a toppled red king sliding off the corner. I BLUNDER runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and WITH CONFIDENCE. closes the line along the bottom.
wear: Wear it to the club, the park tables or the holiday tournament in the living room, or give it to the friend who has never once admitted a bad move.
qa: What is the I Blunder With Confidence tee?

It is a men's chess graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a smug 1950s player, a cracked board and a toppled red king, lettered I BLUNDER WITH CONFIDENCE. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in lightweight 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays comfortable through a long club night.
How do I wash it so the print lasts?

Wash your I Blunder With Confidence tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the cream, mustard, navy and red inks stay crisp through every tournament and every wash.
Is it a good gift for a chess player?

Yes. At $24.99 from Graphic Tees Co. it suits the chess dad, the club friend or the brother who never admits a bad move, and it works for birthdays and Christmas. The free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. I Blunder With Confidence tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and your first size exchange is free.
What colors does it come in?

Graphic Tees Co. offers it in Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Heather Forest and Maroon with cream and mustard ink, and in Natural, Ash and Athletic Heather with navy and red ink so every word stays easy to read. Sizes run S through 4XL, 56 options in all.
